title: M15 — Service Mesh — Baseline
description: Tour the mesh healthy: the injected Envoy sidecar that puts a pod in the mesh, a VirtualService/DestinationRule shaping traffic to session-broker, STRICT mTLS enforced between meshed pods, and the istioctl commands that read what Envoy actually programmed.
